text:
Maria (CS): FYI onboarding check-in for SmallBiz. Their Node SDK init is hitting lots of 429s during CI warmup when they spin up 200 parallel lambdas. Seen this a few times but this customer's renewal is up in 6 weeks so want a smooth path.
Devon (Eng): Can you paste the init snippet + headers and approximate QPS?
Maria (CS): QPS ~800 sustained for ~30s during warmup spike. Here's the init from client: ```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
Redwood.init({ key: process.env.RW_KEY, prefetch: true, maxConcurrency: 0 });
// each lambda forks 50 connections to service on coldstart
```
Maria (CS): Logs show: `HTTP 429 preflight quota exceeded` and ephemeral token churn `token_age=1s` occasionally.
TJ (Infra): Sounds like preflight fanout + ephemeral token TTL + no connection pooling. Recommend two things: reduce parallelism on customer side and enable splay jitter. Also increase ephemeral token TTL to 30s for warmup if possible.
Asha (Solutions): We can schedule a 30m enablement and share a short checklist: reduce concurrency, add jitter, use keepalive, set preflight cache.
Devon (Eng): SDK knobs: set maxConcurrency to 5, prefetch:false for warmup flows, and enable `init({ keepAlive: true })`. Also server-side we can temporarily raise their preflight burst window for onboarding. Need account id to apply.
Maria (CS): Customer id: sb-4492. Henry, are you able to try reducing parallel lambdas to 5 each and re-run warmup for 2 minutes?
Henry (SmallBiz): Trying now. Quick Q: how do we add jitter? We use simple Promise.all to fire requests.
Devon (Eng): Wrap requests with a tiny randomized delay: `await sleep(Math.random()*200)` before each init call, and exponential backoff on 429s. Also add `Retry-After` handling.
SDK Bot: Telemetry: sb-4492 preflight_429_count=132 at 2025-11-08T16:04:07Z, avg_latency_preflight=48ms, token_rotate_rate=1/s
Henry (SmallBiz): Dropped concurrency to 5, added jitter. Re-ran warmup: 429s dropped to 3 over 2m window. Thanks!
Maria (CS): Great. I'll open a support request to bump their preflight window temporarily and schedule the enablement session. Also flagging renewal team — this was a risk but looks mitigated.
Asha (Solutions): I'll send a short checklist doc + runbook for their infra team.
Devon (Eng): For completeness, we'll add a short SDK note to the quickstart: recommend `maxConcurrency` and jitter on high-parallel coldstart patterns.
Maria (CS): Closing loop: Henry wants a follow-up enablement next Wed. I'll coordinate calendar invites. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
